title: ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ULSAN METROPOLITAN CITY, ETC.
full_text:
ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ULSAN METROPOLITAN CITY, ETC.

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to establish Ulsan Metropolitan City, thereby improving convenience in residents' lives and promoting regional development and balanced development of the national territory.

Article 2 (Establishment, etc.)
(1) Ulsan Metropolitan City shall be established under the direct jurisdiction of the Government.
(2) Ulsan-si, Gyeongsangnam-do shall be abolished.

Article 3 (Jurisdiction)
The jurisdiction of Ulsan Metropolitan City shall comprise the entire former Ulsan-si area.

Article 4 (Establishment and Jurisdiction of Gus and Gun)
The names and jurisdictions of the gus and gun established within Ulsan Metropolitan City shall be as follows:
Jung-gu: The former Jung-gu area excluding Songjeong-dong, Hyomun-dong, Yangjeong-dong, Jinjang-dong, and Yeompo-dong.
Nam-gu: The entire former Nam-gu area.
Dong-gu: The entire former Dong-gu area and Yeompo-dong of former Jung-gu.
Buk-gu: Songjeong-dong, Hyomun-dong, Yangjeong-dong, and Jinjang-dong of former Jung-gu, and Nongso-eup and Gangdong-myeon of former Ulju-gu.
Ulju-gun: The former Ulju-gu area excluding Nongso-eup and Gangdong-myeon.

Article 5 (Succession to Affairs)
(1) Affairs of Gyeongsangnam-do or Ulsan-si relating to the jurisdiction under Article 3 at the time this Act enters into force, and affairs administered by the Governor of Gyeongsangnam-do (including the Superintendent of Education of Gyeongsangnam-do), the Mayor of Ulsan-si, or heads of their affiliated agencies (including heads of eup, myeon, and dong; hereinafter the same shall apply), shall be succeeded to, according to their respective jurisdictions, by Ulsan Metropolitan City, the Mayor of Ulsan Metropolitan City (including the Superintendent of Education of Ulsan Metropolitan City), heads of their affiliated agencies, or the relevant gu or gun, head of gu or gun, and heads of their affiliated agencies.
(2) Where it is difficult to distinguish affairs to be succeeded to under paragraph (1), the Minister of Home Affairs (or the Minister of Education in matters concerning education, science, and physical education; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall determine their scope.

Article 6 (Succession to Property)
(1) Ulsan Metropolitan City shall succeed to the public facilities and property of Ulsan-si existing at the time this Act enters into force and the following public facilities and property located within the jurisdiction under Article 3: Provided, That this shall not apply to facilities and property under subparagraph 2 whose establishment purposes are not limited to the jurisdiction under Article 3 or whose nature makes succession by Ulsan Metropolitan City inappropriate, as designated by the Minister of Home Affairs:
1. Public schools among schools under Article 81 of the Education Act, and their property;
2. Public facilities and property of Gyeongsangnam-do other than those under subparagraph 1.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), public facilities and property directly used for administrative purposes by gus and eup, myeon, and dong of Ulsan-si at the time this Act enters into force shall be succeeded to by the relevant gu or gun of Ulsan Metropolitan City.

ADDENDA <Act No. 5243, December 31, 1996>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on July 15, 1997.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures)
(1) Eup, myeon, and dong established in the former Ulsan-si at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed eup, myeon, and dong of the relevant gu or gun of Ulsan Metropolitan City.
(2) Employees and committee members of agencies or facilities of the former Ulsan-si and of agencies or facilities of Gyeongsangnam-do succeeded to by Ulsan Metropolitan City (including employees and members of educational administrative agencies and educational institutions) shall become employees and members belonging to Ulsan Metropolitan City: Provided, That employees and members working in gus and eup, myeon, and dong of the former Ulsan-si shall belong to the relevant gu or gun of Ulsan Metropolitan City.
(3) Dispositions and other acts performed before enforcement of this Act by the Governor of Gyeongsangnam-do (including the Superintendent of Education of Gyeongsangnam-do), the Mayor of Ulsan-si, or heads of their affiliated agencies in connection with the jurisdiction under Article 3 shall be deemed dispositions and acts performed by the Mayor of Ulsan Metropolitan City (including its Superintendent of Education) or the relevant head of gu or gun or affiliated agency, according to their jurisdiction.
(4) Applications for dispositions, reports, and other acts made before enforcement of this Act to the Governor of Gyeongsangnam-do, Mayor of Ulsan-si, or heads of their affiliated agencies concerning the jurisdiction under Article 3 shall be deemed made to the corresponding authorities of Ulsan Metropolitan City or the relevant gu or gun.
(5) Ordinances, rules, and education rules of Gyeongsangnam-do at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed ordinances, rules, and education rules of Ulsan Metropolitan City until corresponding new enactments enter into force.
(6) Ordinances and rules of Ulsan-si at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed ordinances and rules of the relevant gu or gun of Ulsan Metropolitan City until corresponding new enactments enter into force.
(7) Rights and obligations of Gyeongsangnam-do involving monetary payments within the jurisdiction under Article 3 at the time this Act enters into force shall continue to belong to Gyeongsangnam-do.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes)
Where another statute designates all or part of the former Ulsan-si area as a district or jurisdiction, Ulsan Metropolitan City shall be deemed to remain within that district or jurisdiction until the relevant provisions of that statute are first amended after this Act enters into force.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Initial Heads of Local Governments, etc.)
(1) Members of the Ulsan-si Council and members of the Gyeongsangnam-do Council elected in Ulsan-si serving at the time this Act enters into force shall become members of the Ulsan Metropolitan City Council pursuant to Article 28 (4) of the Act on Elections for Public Office and Prevention of Election Malpractices; their terms shall expire on June 30, 1998.
(2) Notwithstanding Article 33 (1) 1 of the Local Autonomy Act and Article 28 (6) of the Act on Elections for Public Office and Prevention of Election Malpractices, members of the Ulsan-si Council and members of the Gyeongsangnam-do Council elected in Ulsan-si shall become members of the council of the gu or gun having jurisdiction over their electoral district, and their terms shall expire on June 30, 1998. During that period, notwithstanding Article 23 of the latter Act, the number of incumbent members shall constitute the prescribed council membership. Where two or more gus or gun have jurisdiction over a former electoral district, the member shall belong to the gu or gun in which the largest number of residents of that electoral district reside.
(3) Notwithstanding Article 30 (1) 1 of the Act on Elections for Public Office and Prevention of Election Malpractices, the incumbent Mayor of Ulsan-si shall become the first Mayor of Ulsan Metropolitan City after this Act enters into force, and the term shall expire on June 30, 1998.
(4) From the enforcement date of this Act until June 30, 1998, heads of gu and gun shall not be elected notwithstanding Article 30 (1) 1 of the Act on Elections for Public Office and Prevention of Election Malpractices. Their duties shall be performed by newly appointed deputy heads of gu and gun under Article 5 (2) of the Addenda to Act No. 4741, partially amending the Local Autonomy Act. The Mayor of Ulsan Metropolitan City shall have authority to recommend their appointment.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
The Act on the Prescribed Number of State Public Officials Assigned to Local Governments shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 1, "directly controlled city" shall be replaced with "metropolitan city"; in Article 2 3, "directly controlled city" shall be replaced with "metropolitan city" and "not more than 105 persons" with "not more than 112 persons"; and in Article 2 4, "directly controlled city" shall be replaced with "metropolitan city" and "not more than 20 persons" with "not more than 21 persons."
